findings.description: The Lambda function embeds a literal AWS access key ID (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE) and secret access key in its environment variables. These are persisted in the Terraform state and readable by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, exposing long-lived credentials that enable credential theft and lateral movement.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving known vulnerabilities in the runtime and bundled libraries unpatched (CWE-1104).
